title: Streetblend
description: Two-player camouflage hide-and-seek using public-domain paintings from the Art Institute of Chicago Open Access collection.

artwork.discovery: Runtime Commons API search across multiple painting genres and public-domain master painters, cached for 7 days.
artwork.randomization: Cryptographic Fisher-Yates shuffle; each painting is used once per deck before reshuffling, with immediate repeats avoided.

loading_behavior: Round timer starts only after the scene image has loaded; remote matches wait for both players to report scene readiness.

hider_controls.resize_rotate: Visible interactive SIZE and ROTATE handles plus two-finger pinch/twist
hider_controls.view: Focus Player and Fit Artwork buttons
hider_controls.sampling: Tap to sample or long-press and slide for continuous magnified eyedropper sampling

seeker_controls: Quick tap guesses, drag pans, pinch zooms. Wrong guesses remove 5 seconds and do not directly subtract score points.

controls.hider: Drag figure to place; pinch figure to resize/rotate; drag background to pan; pinch background to zoom; Sample/Paint/Pose/Lock buttons.
controls.seeker: Quick tap guesses; drag pans; pinch zooms.

figure.manipulation: Drag to place; pinch to resize and rotate.
